evidence.quote: DNA microarray experiment was performed as previously described 6 , on Affymetrix human U133 Plus 2.0 arrays (GeneTitan platform).

evidence.section: Measurement of anti-Meningococcal antibodies by ELISA
evidence.quote: Subclass IgG1 antibodies were measured using mouse anti-human IgG1 (Alpha Diagnostics, San Antonio, TX) conjugated to HRP.

additional_evidence.readouts: IL-6, TNF, IL-12p40 and IL-1b levels

evidence.quote: Cell supernatants were harvested and assessed for IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 using ELISA kits, according to manufacturer’s instructions (BD Biosciences, catalog numbers 555220, 555212, 555171).

aliases: anti- DT IgG capture microsphere assay

evidence.section: Measurement of anti-Diphtheria IgG by Luminex
evidence.quote: Fluorescent microspheres (Luminex Corp, Austin, TX) were covalently conjugated to DT (List Biologicals, Campbell, CA) and used to capture and quantify DT specific IgG in sera based on previous method with minor modifications 53 .
Continuous titers were determined by interpolation of the serum dilution yielding 50% killing as compared to the T 60 growth control plate average.

evidence.section: Measurement of antibody secreting cells by FACS and ELISpot
evidence.quote: Blood ASC were identified by flow cytometry as CD3 neg , CD20 neg , CD38 hi , CD27 hi , CD19 + cells as described previously 56 .

evidence.section: Measurement of antibody secreting cells by FACS and ELISpot
evidence.quote: Antigen specific and total IgG, IgM, and IgA secreting cells were quantified by ELISpot.
